description:

 Function: Semiconductor Test Development / IC Testing

 Experience: 3–14 Years
 Position Code: RF_01 : RF ATE Test Engineer (3-5 Years exp. ) Position Code: RF_02 : Sr RF ATE Test Engineer (5-14 years)
 Employment Type: Full-Time 1. Job Purpose To develop, debug, characterize, and optimize Automated Test Equipment (ATE) test solutions for RF, Analog, and Mixed-Signal semiconductor devices. The role will support the complete product lifecycle, from first-silicon bring-up and characterization to production test release, yield improvement, and high-volume manufacturing. 2. Key Responsibilities A. ATE Test Development Develop, debug, and optimize production test programs for RF, Analog, and Mixed-Signal ICs. Design and implement test solutions using Advantest V93K (SmarTest 8 preferred) or Teradyne UltraFLEX/J750 platforms. Develop and maintain test methodologies to ensure accurate, repeatable, and reliable device measurements. Support test program optimization, test coverage improvement, and production test-time reduction. B. Product Characterization and Validation Support first-silicon bring-up, device characterization, production test development, qualification, and production release. Execute characterization across Process, Voltage, and Temperature (PVT) conditions. Develop and characterize RF, Analog, and Mixed-Signal circuit blocks, including: Phase-Locked Loops (PLLs) Analog-to-Digital Converters (ADCs) Digital-to-Analog Converters (DACs) Oscillators and timing devices Power management circuits RF transceivers and related IPs Correlate ATE measurements with laboratory bench measurements and validation results. C. RF Measurement and Data Analysis Perform RF characterization and testing involving frequency, output power, phase noise, harmonics, linearity, and sensitivity, as applicable to the device under test. Analyze characterization data and identify performance trends, outliers, and potential failure mechanisms. Use data analysis tools such as Excel, MATLAB, Python, or JMP to support engineering decisions. D. Debugging and Yield Improvement Investigate test failures, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Drive yield improvement, test coverage enhancement, and product quality initiatives. Identify opportunities to optimize test time and reduce manufacturing costs without compromising quality or reliability. Support production ramp-up and resolve ATE-related issues in high-volume manufacturing environments. E. Cross-Functional Collaboration and Documentation Collaborate with Design, Product Engineering, Validation, Applications, and Manufacturing teams throughout the product development cycle. Prepare test specifications, characterization reports, test documentation, and production release packages. Support product qualification, release readiness, and ongoing manufacturing improvements. 3. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related discipline. 3–7 years of relevant experience in semiconductor ATE test development, preferably involving RF, Analog, or Mixed-Signal products. Hands-on experience with at least one of the following ATE platforms: Advantest V93K – SmarTest 8 preferred Teradyne UltraFLEX / J750 Strong understanding of RF fundamentals, analog and digital electronics, mixed-signal testing, and semiconductor device characterization. Practical experience in RF measurement and characterization techniques. Familiarity with production test development, device characterization, and test program debugging. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Effective communication and collaboration skills for working in cross-functional engineering teams. 4. Preferred Skills Experience testing RF ICs, PLLs, oscillators, transceivers, wireless connectivity devices, or timing products. Knowledge of RF bench instruments and measurement techniques, where applicable. Understanding of semiconductor product engineering, manufacturing processes, and production release requirements. Experience in statistical data analysis, yield improvement, and systematic failure analysis. Exposure to test-time optimization, cost reduction, and continuous improvement initiatives. Programming or data analysis experience using Python, MATLAB, Excel, or JMP. 5. Key Competencies ATE Test Program Development and Debugging RF and Mixed-Signal Characterization Semiconductor Test Methodologies Data Analysis and Technical Problem-Solving Root-Cause Analysis and Yield Improvement Test-Time Optimization Cross-Functional Collaboration Documentation and Process Discipline 6. Performance Expectations Success in this role will be demonstrated through: Timely development, debugging, and release of production-ready ATE test programs. Improved test coverage, measurement accuracy, and test repeatability. Effective characterization and correlation of ATE and bench results. Measurable contributions to yield improvement and test-time optimization. Timely resolution of production test issues and adherence to product quality requirements. 7. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a hands-on semiconductor test professional with practical ATE programming and debugging experience, a strong foundation in RF and Mixed-Signal electronics, and the ability to support product characterization through production ramp-up.
